framework.north_star: Can a real same-sample or matched-specimen nickelate packet supply P_oe + B_min before superconducting-output reveal, strongly enough to kill or preserve R_oe?
framework.scope_guard: This is not a universal no-go theorem. B's claim is that current literature montage is non-identifiable and that a near-future packet is valid only if it clears explicit row, batch, axis, lab, probe, calibration, and blinding thresholds.

canonical_objects.P_oe: (chi_odd - chi_even) / (chi_odd + chi_even), with a pre-frozen signed-denominator floor and censoring rule
canonical_objects.P_oe_L1: Optional robustness diagnostic using abs(chi_odd)+abs(chi_even) or max-style denominator; it must not be mixed with canonical P_oe.
canonical_objects.B_min: A pre-output baseline vector for oxygen/vacancy, structure/phase fraction, orbital or ligand-hole proxies, disorder/dephasing, pressure/thermal path, ordinary c-axis coherence, and sample quality.

framework.round2_position: B concedes experimental possibility only for a sealed row-level campaign. B rejects any claim from retrospective literature stitching, unblinded matched specimens, or folds that split technical repeats rather than independent specimen lineages.

quantified_falsifier.what_would_falsify_B: A packet falsifies B if it demonstrates that P_oe and B_min can be acquired and analyzed as independent pre-output covariates across enough blinded, batch-separated rows to support held-out residual testing.

required_axes.minimum: At least 4 growth or oxygenation batches; no single batch may contribute more than 40% of complete rows.
required_axes.reason: Prevents sample genealogy from aliasing with P_oe or B_min.

required_axes.minimum: At least 4 independently loaded pressure paths or cells, with pressure medium, hydrostaticity proxy, dwell time, thermal cycling, and unloading/reloading status logged.
required_axes.reason: Pressure path is a treatment variable, not a nuisance label.

required_axes.minimum: At least 3 quantitatively separated oxygen/vacancy or ligand-hole states, measured before output reveal.
required_axes.reason: Separates odd-even susceptibility from oxygen-driven sample-quality selection.

required_axes.minimum: Per-row structural phase fraction under measurement-relevant pressure and temperature, not nominal ambient structure only.
required_axes.reason: Phase fraction can masquerade as both bilayer response and baseline.

required_axes.minimum: At least two counterbalanced probe sequences, with destructive or damage-prone probes placed after P_oe and B_min acquisition or tracked by damage markers.
required_axes.reason: Prevents measurement order from becoming an unmodeled treatment.

P_oe_probe: normal-state qz-resolved RIXS, neutron, or equivalent susceptibility extraction
polarization, geometry, self-absorption, monitor normalization, energy resolution, and covariance retained
pre-frozen denominator floor and censoring rule
B_min_probe: oxygen stoichiometry or vacancy proxy not inferred from the same qz spectral fit
structure and phase fraction under relevant pressure or immediately linked path
orbital, dz2, rare-earth 5d, ligand-hole, or self-doping proxy
ordinary c-axis coherence baseline measured by an independent channel
leakage_control_probe: blind custodian for superconducting output labels
timestamped residual-call lock file before label release
audit trail proving no output-trained labels entered feature selection

statistical_falsifier.primary: B concedes if the residual claim survives leave-one-batch-out and leave-one-lab-out validation with complete-row N >= 36.
statistical_falsifier.effect_stability: The residual sign must be stable in at least 80% of valid held-out folds and must not flip under the pre-registered matrix-element and denominator-floor sensitivity grid.
statistical_falsifier.permutation_controls: Residual alignment must disappear under odd/even label permutation, qz-channel permutation, and output-label permutation using the same pipeline.
statistical_falsifier.missingness_control: The conclusion must survive the pre-frozen U_miss model and a worst-plausible missingness sensitivity analysis.
statistical_falsifier.calibration_control: Raw-to-chi calibration perturbations within declared covariance must not create or erase the residual.

concede_PACKET_FEASIBLE_NOW: An accessible existing packet meets complete_rows_after_censoring_N >= 36.
Rows are same-sample or formally sistered with genealogy, pressure path, oxygen, phase, probe, and blinding logs.
Raw P_oe calibration and independent B_min measurements are available for audit.
Superconducting-output labels were sealed before residual call.
concede_PACKET_FEASIBLE_NEAR_FUTURE: A funded or realistically schedulable campaign can reach rows_total_N >= 48 across at least 4 batches and 3 labs.
All required P_oe, B_min, leakage-control, and negative-control blocks are specified before measurement.
At least one pilot batch demonstrates that P_oe extraction and B_min acquisition can be done without sharing qz/c-axis calibration internals.
A blind-custody protocol is operational before any superconducting-output measurement is released.
do_not_concede: Only one or two laboratories or one dominant batch supply the rows.
B_min uses features derived from the same qz/polarization spectral fit that defines P_oe.
Output labels are already known during row selection, feature selection, calibration tuning, or censoring.
Matched specimens lack growth, oxygenation, pressure-path, and phase-fraction genealogy.

packet_nonidentifiability_criteria.nonidentifiable_if: Any B_min component is computed from the same fitted qz/polarization/form-factor parameters used to estimate chi_odd or chi_even, unless it is explicitly treated as part of P_oe uncertainty rather than an independent baseline.

Tc, zero resistance, Meissner, diamagnetism, gap, spin resonance, critical current, or output-trained labels are available before row inclusion, calibration, censoring, feature selection, residual model selection, or residual call.
Batch, lab, pressure cell, probe family, or specimen source predicts P_oe/B_min block membership strongly enough that leave-one-batch-out or leave-one-lab-out validation cannot be run.
A row combines P_oe from one specimen with B_min or output from a different specimen without same-boule genealogy, shared oxygenation, matched pressure path, and phase-fraction evidence.
More than 25% of candidate rows depend on denominator-floor rescue, or residual sign changes when the pre-registered floor varies over the allowed sensitivity grid.
The residual appears only under one raw-to-chi calibration choice and disappears under plausible polarization leakage, self-absorption, geometry, monitor, or matrix-element covariance perturbations.
Complete blinded rows after censoring are fewer than 24, or fewer than 3 independent batches, or fewer than 2 independent labs.
Missingness, censoring, or sample loss is correlated with output labels or output-proxy knowledge and is not covered by pre-frozen U_miss.

nonidentifiability_boundary.structural_boundary_statement: The boundary is crossed from hard non-identifiability to testable packet only when P_oe, B_min, calibration, row genealogy, and output blinding are all fixed before residual evaluation, and when independent variation across batch, lab, pressure, oxygen, structure, and probe order prevents a single latent sample-quality axis from explaining the residual.
nonidentifiability_boundary.near_future_possibility: A near-future campaign is not structurally impossible if it treats pressure path, oxygen/vacancy state, phase fraction, and calibration as first-class measured variables and if it avoids deriving B_min from the same qz response that defines P_oe.
nonidentifiability_boundary.structural_impossibility_trigger: If every feasible P_oe probe necessarily requires the same c-axis/qz/orbital calibration quantities that B_min must independently regress out, then R_oe is structurally non-identifiable for this packet class. Round 2 cannot prove that universal trigger from the allowed files; it can only define the audit needed to test it.

P_oe_B_min_independence_audit.audit_question: Can B_min be measured and frozen without importing the fitted odd/even susceptibility extraction state or superconducting-output knowledge?
pass_requires_all: Separate raw data stores for P_oe and B_min before analysis merge.
Separate analyst teams or locked scripts for P_oe extraction and B_min feature construction.

A declared forbidden-information list for B_min: chi_odd, chi_even, P_oe, qz-fit residuals, odd/even channel assignment confidence, superconducting-output labels, and post-output sample selection notes.
A declared forbidden-information list for P_oe extraction: B_min residual outcome, superconducting-output labels, and feature-selection feedback from B_min models.
Shared metadata limited to specimen genealogy, timestamp, pressure/temperature grid, and predeclared calibration constants.
Hash-locked raw calibration archive and analysis scripts before label reveal.
An external blind custodian certifies that output labels were unavailable until residual calls were locked.
fail_conditions: B_min c-axis coherence is numerically derived from the same qz spectral decomposition used to compute P_oe.
P_oe censoring thresholds are tuned after inspecting B_min or output correlations.
Rows are dropped because their eventual superconducting output is known or suspected.
Lab, instrument, or pressure cell identity is inseparable from P_oe versus B_min block acquisition.
Matrix-element corrections are adjusted using structural or orbital features that are later treated as independent B_min covariates without covariance propagation.

P_oe_B_min_independence_rating.green: No shared fitted parameters; only predeclared metadata shared; raw covariance propagated; output labels sealed.
P_oe_B_min_independence_rating.yellow: Some shared calibration constants or pressure metadata, but no shared fitted qz/c-axis state and sensitivity analysis covers the overlap.
P_oe_B_min_independence_rating.red: B_min and P_oe reuse the same fitted qz/c-axis/orbital state, or output knowledge enters before residual lock.

P_oe_B_min_independence_audit.B_min_independence_threshold: At least 80% of complete rows must be green; no red rows may enter the primary residual test. Yellow rows may enter only a secondary sensitivity analysis.

P_oe_definition_audit.pass: Canonical P_oe and any P_oe_L1 diagnostic are stored as separate fields with separate censoring flags.
P_oe_definition_audit.fail: A stabilized denominator is silently substituted for canonical P_oe or compared directly to prior P_oe claims.

B_min_minimality_audit.pass: B_min includes only pre-output, predeclared variables needed to block ordinary oxygen, structure, orbital, disorder, pressure, c-axis, and sample-quality explanations.
B_min_minimality_audit.fail: B_min expands after label reveal or includes output-proxy variables selected because they improve residual alignment.

minimum_valid_design.row_unit: Same crystal under one logged pressure/thermal path, or a formally sistered specimen set from the same boule/growth and oxygenation batch with documented splitting, matched pressure path, phase-fraction check, and probe-order log.
probe_order: Assign row IDs, genealogy, pressure-path plan, output-blinding custodian, U_miss, censoring, denominator floor, and analysis hashes.
Acquire non-output B_min blocks that are least destructive: oxygen/vacancy proxy, ambient and in situ structure where possible, sample quality, disorder/dephasing.
Load pressure path and log pressure medium, hydrostaticity proxy, dwell time, pressure gradient, thermal cycling, and damage checks.
Acquire normal-state P_oe raw channels on the frozen temperature, qz, polarization, and form-factor grid.
Acquire independent ordinary c-axis coherence and orbital/ligand-hole/self-doping proxies without using fitted P_oe states.
Lock P_oe, B_min, U_miss, censoring, calibration covariance, and residual-call scripts.
Only then release or measure superconducting-output labels for validation.
minimum_valid_design.lab_independence_rule: Labs count as independent only if they do not share the same analyst for P_oe and B_min extraction, do not reuse a single calibration pipeline without covariance audit, and contribute rows from at least two different batch or pressure-path lineages.
minimum_valid_design.probe_independence_rule: Probe families count as independent only if their raw observables are not downstream transforms of the same qz/polarization spectral fit and if destructive or damage-prone effects are logged before the next probe block.

gray_zone.small_N_gray_zone_definition: A packet with 24 to 35 complete blinded rows after censoring, at least 3 batches, and at least 2 labs is neither valid for preserving/killing R_oe nor dead by design. It can be used only as a pilot to estimate variance, denominator censoring rate, calibration sensitivity, and feasibility of the full campaign.
allowed_claims_in_gray_zone: whether full N >= 36 complete rows is realistic
gray_zone_exit_to_valid: Reach at least 4 growth or oxygenation batches.
Pass independence audit with >=80% green rows and zero red primary rows.
gray_zone_exit_to_nonidentifiable: Complete blinded rows remain <24 after two realistic acquisition batches.
P_oe and B_min cannot be separated without shared fitted qz/c-axis/orbital states.
Output labels cannot be kept sealed during row selection or calibration.
Batch/lab/probe identity remains aliased with the target residual.

claims.claim: Current literature assembly remains non-identifiable because no complete leakage-clean same-sample or blinded matched-specimen P_oe + B_min packet was identified in the allowed state files.
A valid packet requires at least 36 complete blinded rows after censoring, with 48 total target rows, 4 batches, 3 labs, and validation that holds out batch and lab lineages.
Rows below 24 complete blinded specimens are non-identifiable for R_oe because crossfit cannot distinguish residual physics from batch, lab, pressure-cell, or calibration effects.
Rows from 24 to 35 complete blinded specimens define a small-N gray zone that can guide campaign design but cannot kill or preserve R_oe.
B_min independence fails if B_min reuses fitted qz/c-axis/orbital states from the P_oe extraction pipeline or if superconducting-output knowledge enters any pre-residual decision.

B should concede PACKET_FEASIBLE_NEAR_FUTURE if a sealed campaign can operationally satisfy the minimum valid design and a pilot proves that P_oe extraction and B_min acquisition can remain information-separated.
B should concede PACKET_FEASIBLE_NOW only if an already accessible dataset meets the same thresholds with raw calibration, genealogy, blinding, and held-out validation intact.

This round does not prove structural impossibility of all future campaigns; it defines the audit that would expose such impossibility if every feasible B_min baseline necessarily shares the P_oe extraction state.

inspector_check.A_independence: Did not read current-CphiPacket/A or any A output. This file uses only the user-allowed plan, B round1, inspector_B_round1, and PI synthesis inputs.
inspector_check.P_oe_definition_guard: Canonical P_oe is kept as signed-sum denominator with censoring/floor rules; P_oe_L1 is named only as a separate robustness diagnostic.
inspector_check.B_min_independence_guard: Separate scripts alone are declared insufficient; independence requires forbidden-information lists, raw-store separation, analyst/script locking, covariance propagation, and output blinding.
inspector_check.main_residual_risk: The numeric thresholds are B's decision-grade protocol thresholds, not empirically optimized power calculations. A later statistician/inspector should stress-test N=36/48 against measured variance once pilot data exist.
